subject: POC pressure: benchmarking findings and renewal window
messages:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@brightfront.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightFront POC results and renewal timeline

Diego,

Quick note — we ran a short POC with CompetitorAI last week and they returned a performance/cost summary this morning. We're now under active pressure from our procurement and product teams to validate which provider will run the recommended inference stack for our recommendation engine. Renewal with Redwood is coming up on 2026-11-10, and the execs want concrete numbers from both sides before committing.

I've attached the competitor POC summary (high level) so you can see the test scope and metrics. Key asks from our side: a like-for-like benchmark (latency tail, cost per 1M tokens, multi-tenant vs dedicated comparison) and a short note on how Redwood would handle our 120M-month token profile if we moved to Dedicated.

Olivia
Olivia Turner
VP Product, BrightFront
olivia.turner@brightfront.com

Attachments: brightfront_competitor_poc_summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@brightfront.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightFront POC results and renewal timeline

Thanks for the note and the summary, Olivia — appreciate the transparency. I'm sorry to hear you're under pressure; we should be able to move quickly.

Plan proposal:
- Run a focused benchmark that mirrors your competitor test vectors (tail latency, p50/p95, tokenized cost) using a Dedicated pool matching your target throughput.
- Provide a short executive comparison (3 slides) and a cost model for both Hosted and Dedicated modes.
- Offer a temporary capacity burst and a 30-day grace on token overage for the pilot window.

Looping in Marissa (CS) and Monica (SE) to own test setup and test harness. Marissa — can you prepare a MAP with milestones and minimum success criteria? Monica — can you confirm whether we can spin a Dedicated pool in us-west-2 for the benchmark next week?

I'd also like to understand the competitive pricing they shared so we can mirror scenarios.

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_benchmark_plan.pdf (proposal skeleton)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@brightfront.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightFront POC results and renewal timeline

Hi Olivia — thanks for sharing the summary. I've drafted a mutual action plan (attached) with a tight two-week timeline so we can get definitive numbers before your procurement window. Highlights:

- Day 0: data sharing (anonymized sample payloads + test vectors)
- Day 2–5: SE-run benchmarks across Hosted (burst), Dedicated baseline, and a quantized variant; we will capture p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, and cost per 1M tokens
- Day 6–10: joint review, parity checklist, and decision criteria (latency delta & cost delta thresholds)
- Day 11–14: executive summary and recommended contract amendment or short extension to allow rollout

Success criteria: p95 within 20% of competitor and non-inferior total cost at production scale (accounting for cache/batch improvements).

We can start as soon as we have the sample test vectors. Monica — confirmed we can provision a small Dedicated pool for the window in us-west-2; I'll coordinate access.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP_BrightFront.xlsx (mutual action plan)

From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@brightfront.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@brightfront.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightFront POC results and renewal timeline

Team — attaching the competitor test vectors and a short note from procurement. A few clarifications up front:

- Competitor quoted $1.8 per 1M tokens for their Dedicated-like offering at our volume; they're also offering a two-quarter commit at a 20% discount if we sign immediately.
- Product wants the p95 latency at the 10k rps mix.
- Procurement is asking for a term extension option of 60 days if we need to finish an in-depth benchmark.

Procurement (copied) — happy to provide more if needed, but we need a quick turnaround on both the numbers and a proposed commercial accommodation.

Olivia

Attachments: competitor_test_vectors.json (sample set), procurement_note_brief.txt

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@brightfront.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@brightfront.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightFront POC results and renewal timeline

Olivia / Procurement —

Thanks — we've reviewed the vectors and the competitor pricing. Quick replies and proposed commercial path:

1) Benchmark: SE team can execute the like-for-like run Monday–Wednesday next week. We'll deliver a concise p95/p99 and cost delta report by Thursday.
2) Pricing: to stay competitive, I'm proposing we offer:
   - A two-month extension at the current rate (no penalties) so BrightFront has time to finish evaluation, and
   - A pilot pricing adjustment for the benchmark window (one-time 12% credit on billed tokens during the pilot), plus the option to agree a baseline Reserved commitment if you choose Dedicated.
3) Capacity: Monica confirmed Dedicated pool availability in us-west-2 for the benchmark (small pool sized to match your 10k rps mix).

I've created the HubSpot opp for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7832 — can procurement confirm whether an interim PO or a short contract amendment is acceptable for the extension?

Rishi — looping you in because this may require a discretionary credit approval beyond standard AM thresholds. Short ask: approve up to a 15% one-time credit on pilot consumption if the SE results expose a material regression we need to remediate.

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_benchmark_plan.pdf (updated)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightFront POC results and renewal timeline

Diego / team —

Approve the proposed path. Offer details: authorized up to a 10% one-time credit during the pilot (we need to avoid setting a higher precedent), and provide an executive one-page summary and cost comparison for BrightFront. If the SE report shows regression beyond the threshold in the MAP, we should cover remediation engineering time for a limited window.

Diego — please prepare the customer-facing executive summary and the amendment language we can use for a 60-day extension option. Marissa — prioritize the MAP review and SE schedule. Monica — confirm provisioning ETA and share access details with BrightFront before Monday morning.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference
